analogy.rationale: PPARs are nuclear receptors with limited expression in most of these cell lines, so PPAR agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other nuclear receptor ligands (PPAR antagonist, FXR/LXR agonists) that share the nuclear receptor pathway, with metabolic classes like insulin sensitizers and fatty acid synthase inhibitors as weaker downstream analogs.
